## Attendance

The programme board met in March 2024. Attendees were J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, M. Chen. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting.

The board confirmed the attendance record and considered the matters set out below. Members were reminded that the minutes should provide a clear record of performance, current items, and any follow-up required.

## Performance

The board reviewed activity for March 2024. There were 2595 captures during the period.

The reported grader backlog was 316. The board also noted 61 letter breaches. These figures were recorded for monitoring through the programme’s routine performance review. Members considered the position and agreed that the reported activity and outstanding work should remain visible in subsequent discussions.

## Items

The board considered CHG-0171 Grader rota moved to long sessions. The item was noted, with a report back requested from the owner. The board agreed that any relevant progress should be reflected in the next update.

## Actions

The chair will circulate actions arising from the meeting. The owner of CHG-0171 Grader rota moved to long sessions will report back on progress. The performance figures and the position on the grader backlog and letter breaches will continue to be monitored.
